facts.paraphrase: The announced foundry agreement runs through 2040 subject to termination terms. It includes wafer inventory/offtake arrangements and annual minimum offtake for specified 10nm wafers. Early manufacturing discontinuation can trigger $2.25B compensation, with stated exceptions and a later annual reduction; specified defect claims have separate caps.
The majority divestiture closed September 12, 2025. The closing notice does not restate the foundry commercial schedule.
Intel confirms an operating wafer manufacturing and sale agreement with Altera and recognized $126M Q3 and $446M nine-month 2026 revenue. Most transition corporate services ceased March 28, 2026.

assessment.supports: A continuing external customer relationship has contractual support beyond a one-quarter spot sale; useful corroboration of the normalized legacy Foundry revenue category.
does_not_prove: Annual 2027–30 Altera sales of $640M obtained by annualizing H1 2026.
Flat revenue, margins, cash collection or 3% post-2030 growth.
Continuity of this particular contract beyond 2040.
That all announced 2025 commercial terms survived closing unchanged; current filings confirm operations but do not reproduce the full agreement.
assessment.model_treatment: Keep existing normalized revenue as an analyst assumption and recognize no incremental Foundry profit. Continuing production does not by itself trigger a termination payment. A shutdown case must assess the contingent payment and remaining operating commitments together, without also reserving the full amount in a continuing-production base.
assessment.terminal_treatment: The 2041+ legacy revenue continuation implicitly assumes renewal, replacement customers or successor production. Label this assumption; the announced agreement is not evidence of perpetuity.
assessment.capital_controls_limit: Legacy-revenue-only controls change the capital denominator while holding aggregate Foundry profit fixed. They are accounting/reinvestment sensitivities, not full economic downside cases for a lost customer.

search_limit: Read announcement, closing notice and current operating disclosure; no public final detailed pricing/offtake schedule found in targeted official filing searches.
